# Third-party app theming.
#  - GTK 3/4 and Kvantum themes: generated at build time from every
#    theme/*/theme.json by tools/gen-toolkit-themes.py (one theme per scheme).
#  - Icons, cursor sources and sounds: generated by tools/gen-*.py, committed,
#    and kept in sync by ctests.
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set(toolkit_out ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/share)
file(GLOB scheme_jsons CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/theme/*/theme.json)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/toolkit-themes.stamp
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rm -rf ${toolkit_out}
    COMMAND Python3::Interpreter ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/gen-toolkit-themes.py
            --out ${toolkit_out} --theme-root ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/theme
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/toolkit-themes.stamp
    DEPENDS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/gen-toolkit-themes.py
            ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/gen-labwc-theme.py
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gtk.css.in
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/kvantum/MeadowLuna.kvconfig.in
            ${scheme_jsons}
    COMMENT "Generating GTK and Kvantum themes from theme.json"
    VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(meadow-toolkit-themes ALL DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/toolkit-themes.stamp)
install(DIRECTORY ${toolkit_out}/themes/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/themes)
install(DIRECTORY ${toolkit_out}/Kvantum/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/Kvantum)

# Icon theme (tools/gen-icons.py; aliases are symlinks, kept as such).
install(DIRECTORY icons/meadow-icons/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/meadow-icons)
# Cursor theme: XCursor files built from the committed SVG sources.
find_program(RSVG_CONVERT rsvg-convert)
find_program(XCURSORGEN xcursorgen)
if(RSVG_CONVERT AND XCURSORGEN)
    file(GLOB cursor_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cursors/src/*)
    set(cursor_out ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/meadow-cursors)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cursors.stamp
        COMMAND ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/gen-cursors.sh ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cursors/src ${cursor_out}
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cursors.stamp
        DEPENDS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/gen-cursors.sh ${cursor_sources}
        COMMENT "Building the meadow-cursors XCursor theme"
        VERBATIM)
    add_custom_target(meadow-cursors ALL DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cursors.stamp)
    install(DIRECTORY ${cursor_out}/cursors DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/meadow-cursors)
else()
    message(WARNING "rsvg-convert or xcursorgen not found: meadow-cursors is installed without cursors")
endif()
install(FILES cursors/meadow-cursors/index.theme DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/icons/meadow-cursors)
# Sound theme (tools/gen-sounds.py; pcm.sha256 stays in the source tree).
install(FILES sounds/meadow/index.theme DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/sounds/meadow)
install(DIRECTORY sounds/meadow/stereo DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/sounds/meadow)
